project_type: Next.js 16 monorepo (Yarn 4 workspaces) - AI video editor
build_system: Yarn 4 workspaces. Web app at apps/web/
test_framework: vitest with vi.mock, vi.fn patterns. Tests co-located as *.test.ts alongside source.
verification_instructions: 1. Run yarn workspace web typecheck (must pass with no errors). 2. Run yarn workspace web test (all tests must pass).
setup_instructions: cd /projects/sandbox/anything-clipper && corepack enable && yarn install (already done)
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network. No Docker daemon available. Node 22 pre-installed. ffmpeg available.
contribution_requirements: CI runs typecheck then test. No linter enforcement currently.
key_patterns: 1. AI gateway at apps/web/src/app/api/utils/ai.ts uses chatCompletion/chatCompletionJson with JsonSchemaSpec. 2. TTS at src/lib/tts/generate.ts already has OpenAI direct fallback pattern (priority: proxy first, then OPENAI_API_KEY). 3. Image gen at src/lib/assets/image-gen.ts returns null when not configured (graceful). 4. Frontend uses shadcn/ui components, dark theme (bg-[#07070f]), violet/pink gradients, Lucide icons, TanStack Query, auth via better-auth useSession. 5. API routes at src/app/api/ use getApiUser for auth.
directory_structure: apps/web/src/app/ - Next.js app router pages. apps/web/src/app/api/ - API routes. apps/web/src/lib/ - shared libraries (tts, assets, ugc, etc). apps/web/src/components/ui/ - shadcn/ui components. apps/web/src/utils/ - client utilities.
